name: Earthen Arise
statusNote: Changed in Forever. New rewards: Raptorcrest Bracers. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
You have uncovered a dark threat to the land, champion. The Resonite cask you have found in that cave houses a slumbering Earthen by the name of Goggeroc.

I have changed the mixture of the Resonite crystals that you gathered with my shamanistic powers. Take the enchanted Resonite crystal and smash open the Resonite cask, which houses the Earthen.

When awakened, Goggeroc will be weakened... Slay him, adventurer!
narrative.objectives: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.
narrative.offerRewardText: You bear good news, champion! I fear the possibilities of what an Earthen would mean to Kalimdor.Slaying Goggeroc was a task for no one less then a hero. You have done well; all of Stonetalon and Kalimdor are indebted to you, noble champion.Accept this as your reward most honored one.
narrative.requestItemsText: I fear if we do not dispose of this threat immediately, all of Stonetalon will be lost. The might of an Earthen can not be matched by any means. When awakened, Goggeroc will be weak from his long slumber, this will be the opportunity that you must take advantage of... go now adventurer!

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 18 to 20, 2,900 XP in all.

quests.name: Boulderslide Ravine
quests.objectiveText: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

quests.name: Earthen Arise
quests.objectiveText: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc.
